prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake and proper meal timing around a 90-minute morning run

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all 3 meals plus pre/post-workout nutrition around the 90-minute run
Total daily carbohydrates align with endurance athlete needs (8-10g per kg body weight)
All meals and snacks are vegetarian and nut-free
Meal plan is presented in compact, single-day format with clear timing
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-performance endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and strength through weightlifting with optimized pre/post-workout nutrition

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers 1 full day with at least 4 meals/snacks strategically timed around workout
Protein intake meets or exceeds 1.6-2.2g per kg body weight (136-187g total)
Pre-workout meal consumed 2-3 hours before training; post-workout meal within 1-2 hours after
Plan is compact and concise (under 400 words)
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) with elevated protein requirements and strategic meal timing around workout windows

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and improve endurance for competitive cycling

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals and includes snacks totaling approximately 2,800-3,200 calories
Each meal contains plant-based protein sources (legumes, tofu, nuts, seeds) meeting ~1.6-1.8g protein per kg bodyweight
Includes micronutrient-rich foods addressing common vegan athlete gaps (iron, B12, calcium, omega-3s)
Meals are practical, concise, and suitable for a single day without excessive preparation time
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an athlete with dietary restrictions (vegan/vegetarian) requiring creative protein and micronutrient sourcing while maintaining performance nutrition principles
